missing_bar_definition: Measured against the instrument's DECLARED venue session contract (spot FX 17:00 America/New_York Sun-Fri; XAUUSD CME Globex 17:00 America/Chicago with a daily 16:00-17:00 halt), not a naive 24/7 grid.
